But stocking only ~80-100 units/day and selling ~90 means near-balanced. Good. So each day: refill the emptiest high-demand slots. 

Constraints: fills limited to 8. Prioritize HIGHEST demand slots: large snacks (crisps, tortilla) and large drinks (energy, oat, cola), at MAIN (highest footfall 1.8x) and AI-HOUSE (1.3x). AI-LOUNGE lower footfall but picky.
